description: EE1: Transform needs neither Pokemon transformed already. p1's Imposter Ditto (Choice Scarf) starts transformed into p2's Ditto (Limber) opposite it: a Ditto again, with a 5-PP copy of Transform. The turn: p1's Ditto (faster: Choice Scarf) uses that Transform on Chansey and fails (the user is transformed; PP 5 -> 4, choice lock on Transform, which it knows); p2's Ditto's Transform at p1's Ditto fails (the target is transformed; PP 12 -> 11).
